newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunker demand down, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunker demand down, rates steady.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker enquiries fell on Friday although ARA quotes were barely changed and enquiries were thin, dealers said.
One dealer said demand reached only 15,000 tonnes, down from Thursday's 20,000 tonnes when fuel oil bunkers rose very slightly and competition for sales was stronger.
"There is low bunker demand in the ARA area and numbers are unchanged. You are still looking at $84 today," a dealer said.
Hamburg prices rose about $2 a tonne to $91/$92 FOB on better enquiry.
"Avails are small but the market is quiet," a Hamburg dealer said of the higher offers.
There was marginal movement on Arabian Gulf cargoes which were down 25 cents. "There is not much enquiry about," a broker said.
Suez prices also were unchanged except for gas oil, which gained $1 reflecting stronger numbers in the Med.
